item.title: Planning my GTAO Empire
item.description:
I learned today that I could migrate my old GTAO account over, so I have. That’s pretty exciting, because it means that I have access to all the vehicles and properties that I used to have.

But, this also means that I should figure out the gameplay loop of these things - something I didn’t really do when I was acquiring them, and it’s changed a lot anyway.
